register.labelZh: STRAIGHTEN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: STRAIGHTEN 片語動詞可以描述道路變直、把物件弄直或某人挺直身體。；straighten something out 可以用來談論預訂錯誤、付款問題、誤會和其他混亂情況。；straighten somebody out 和 straighten yourself out 可以描述某人改善行為,或重新掌握自己的生活。；straighten something up 可以自然地請別人整理房間、書桌、櫃枱或其他地方。
register.summaryEn: Straighten expressions can describe a road becoming straight, an object being made straight or a person standing upright. Straighten something out is useful when discussing booking mistakes, payment problems, misunderstandings and other confusing situations. Straighten somebody out and straighten yourself out can describe a person improving their behaviour or taking control of their life again. Straighten something up is a useful way to ask someone to tidy a room, desk, counter or other space.
